import * as d3 from 'd3'

export const meta = {
  title: 'Share of traffic',
  kind: 'dataviz',
}

export function mount(el, ctx) {
  el.innerHTML = '<h2>Share of traffic</h2>'
  const svg = d3.select(el).append('svg')
  svg.append('rect').attr('width', 40).attr('height', 20)
  return () => {
    el.innerHTML = ''
  }
}
